business_summary: Jiangsu Jiangyin Rural Commercial Bank Co.,LTD. provides various personal and corporate banking products and services in China. The company operates through Corporate Business, Personal Business, Treasury Business, and others segments. It offers fixed, current, smart, notice, time, and demand deposits, as well as deposit certificates; gold, mortgage, and personal business and consumption loans; business operating, project, syndicated, agricultural, fund pool, auction, commercial property, revolving, technology, and green energy loans; and corporate finance. The company also provides citizen, debit, and credit cards; international remittance, foreign currency exchange and settlement, and clean collection; and agency funds, precious metal sales, and third-party custody services. In addition, it offers letter of credit, documentary and clean collection, packaged loans, export bill purchase, forfaiting, export invoice financing, offshore non-financing guarantee, credit insurance, import bill purchase, import payment, and bill pledge financing; and cross border RMB business, online and mobile banking, Wechat bank, golden neighborhood, convenient services, points mall, cashier services, and micro finance products. Further, the company offers transactional financial instruments, bond investment, repurchase and resale bond business, and interbank lending business. Jiangsu Jiangyin Rural Commercial Bank Co.,LTD. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Jiangyin, China.
